description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Input' which performs validation and filtering for attributes of input elements within an HTML Purifier library. It implements logic to handle attributes like 'type', 'checked', 'maxlength', 'size', 'src', and 'value', adjusting them according to specific rules.
